title: Personnel of the three-saxophone sextet
summary: He confirms Bumps Myers, Maxwell Davis and Marshall Royal with Eddie Beal and Chico Hamilton, and mentions "You're Part of Me" with a Felicia Sanders lyric.

blocks.x: On those dates where they say the details are uncertain, to your recollection did you have both saxophones?
Yeah, and I had Bumps and...
So the two of them were both there together.
Both of them are there together. And Eddie Beal played piano, and...let's see...Chico Hamilton played
drums. I didn't use the guitar. So it was just... Let's see, Marshall Royal played alto, Bumps Myers and...
